fixtures.name: _valid_baseline
fixtures.description: Genuinely well-formed GGUF (verified via gguf-py's independent GGUFReader). Every other fixture in this corpus is a single corruption applied to this file.

fixtures.name: unsupported_version
fixtures.description: Version field set to 999 (only version 3 is the first supported tuple).
fixtures.gguf_py_detail: ValueError: Sorry, file appears to be version 999 which we cannot handle

fixtures.name: truncated_header
fixtures.description: File cut off after magic+version, before tensor_count/kv_count.
fixtures.gguf_py_detail: ValueError: not enough values to unpack (expected 2, got 0)

fixtures.name: truncated_metadata
fixtures.description: File cut off partway through the first metadata key's string bytes.
fixtures.gguf_py_detail: IndexError: index 0 is out of bounds for axis 0 with size 0

fixtures.name: truncated_tensor_data
fixtures.description: Last 10 bytes of tensor data removed; tensor extent now exceeds file size.
fixtures.gguf_py_detail: ValueError: When changing to a larger dtype, its size must be a divisor of the total size in bytes of the last axis of the array.

fixtures.name: huge_tensor_count
fixtures.description: tensor_count field set to 10 billion while file contains 1 real tensor descriptor.
fixtures.expected_reason: tensor_count exceeds configured cap (10,000) and/or file size cannot support it
fixtures.gguf_py_detail: IndexError: index 0 is out of bounds for axis 0 with size 0

fixtures.name: integer_overflow_dims
fixtures.description: Tensor dims (8589934592, 8589934592) whose element-count product overflows when multiplied by element size, while actual data is 4 bytes.
fixtures.expected_reason: dimension product overflow / declared extent exceeds file size
fixtures.gguf_py_detail: ValueError: cannot reshape array of size 0 into shape (8589934592,8589934592)

fixtures.name: invalid_metadata_type
fixtures.description: Metadata value_type tag set to 255, not a valid GGUF type enum value (0-12).
fixtures.gguf_py_detail: ValueError: np.uint32(255) is not a valid GGUFValueType

fixtures.name: invalid_utf8_string
fixtures.description: A string metadata value contains raw invalid-UTF-8 bytes (0xFF 0xFE).

fixtures.name: duplicate_metadata_key
fixtures.gguf_py_detail: KeyError: 'Duplicate general.architecture already in list at offset 69'

fixtures.name: duplicate_tensor_name
fixtures.gguf_py_detail: ValueError: Found duplicated tensor with name dup.weight

fixtures.name: zero_dimension
fixtures.description: Tensor descriptor has a dimension of 0.

fixtures.name: unsupported_dtype
fixtures.description: Tensor type field set to 99, not a supported ggml_type for the first tuple (F32 only).
fixtures.gguf_py_detail: ValueError: np.uint32(99) is not a valid GGMLQuantizationType

fixtures.name: misaligned_tensor_offset
fixtures.description: Tensor offset field set to 5, not a multiple of the 32-byte alignment.

fixtures.name: overlapping_tensors
fixtures.description: Two distinct tensors ('first.weight', 'second.weight') both declare offset=0, overlapping.

fixtures.name: inconsistent_dimensions
fixtures.description: llama.embedding_length metadata says 999 but token_embd.weight's actual last dimension is 4.
fixtures.expected_reason: tensor dimension does not match declared metadata dimension

gguf_py_comparison_summary.purpose: gguf-py is an established, independent parser -- NOT the strict OrcEngine Phase 2 parser. Fixtures it silently accepts mark exactly where OrcEngine's own parser must be stricter than the current ecosystem norm.
